blocks.x: Driisti Smart Vision Glasses — Overview in production terms — the runtime that holds it, the policies that bound it, the dashboards that prove it, and the quarterly delta your finance team can bank.

Driisti Smart Vision Glasses operationalizes AI governance: the policy layer (NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, EU AI Act mapping), model registry with technical documentation, evaluation puts to work with red-team suites, guardrail configuration, incident response for AI events, and the evidence pack that turns conformity assessment into a formality.

blocks.title: Driisti Smart Vision Glasses — control and evidence planes
blocks.note: The fabric routes each decision through the same contract: score with reasons, policy check, human checkpoint where the mandate says so.

blocks.x: Every component in Driisti Smart Vision Glasses — Overview has a contract, a version and a named owner. When something drifts, the ticket goes to a person, not to a committee — that is what the reference architecture is for.

Compass is where AI programs stop being risky: every model carries its model card, its evaluation results, its guardrail configuration and its control owner. High-risk use cases (credit scoring, employment, medical) get the documentation, human-oversight and post-market monitoring the EU AI Act actually requires — built in, not bolted on.
